# GritTrack

## Stack
- **API:** ASP.NET Core Web API (.NET 10), JWT auth, switchable JSON/SQL repository
- **App:** .NET MAUI (Android), MVVM pattern, SecureStorage for tokens
- **Database:** SQL Server in Docker, EF Core migrations
- **Domain:** Course tracking (grades, credits, GPA calculation)

## Code Style
- **No var** - typed declarations only (string, int, bool, the real stuff)
- **Comments with personality** - section headers like CSS blocks, plus inline WHY/WHAT
- **OOP modularly** - reusable logic gets its own controller or modal, injected when needed
- **Repository pattern** - database access behind a data store so we're never married to one SQL flavor

## Project Structure
```
GritTrack.Api/          # ASP.NET Core API
  Controllers/          # Thin, calls service once
  DTOs/                 # Request/Response, never the Model
  Models/               # Domain entities
  Repositories/         # JSON + SQL implementations
  Services/             # Business rules
  Data/                 # DbContext, JSON files

GritTrack/              # MAUI app
  PageModels/           # ViewModels (MVVM)
  Pages/                # XAML views
  Services/             # API client, auth, navigation
```

## Running It
